observations: Photo 0: A large, dark-colored freestanding cooker with multiple burners and two ovens, placed in a tiled outdoor or semi-outdoor space. The brand name 'Hobart' is visible on the front panel above the knobs.
Photo 1: Top-down view of the cooktop showing a flat induction zone on the left and four gas burners on the right. The control knobs are visible below the cooktop.

Photo 2: Closer top-down view of the cooktop, confirming the induction zone and gas burners. The induction zone has a smooth black surface, and the gas burners have metal grates. No visible damage to the cooktop surface.
The cooker is in a non-kitchen environment, possibly a balcony or utility area, with visible electrical wiring and boxes on the wall behind it.
The unit appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear, but no obvious damage or rust.

identity.kind: freestanding gas and induction cooker with double oven

claims.claim: Neatly used, easy clean and well functional cooker.
claims.evidence: Photos show the cooker is clean and in decent condition, but functionality cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Uses both induction and gas cooking
claims.evidence: Photo 1 and Photo 2 clearly show a flat induction zone on the left and four gas burners on the right.
Photo 0 shows two oven doors below the cooktop, confirming the presence of ovens.

risks.risk: The induction zone may not be functional or may have damaged coils.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the induction zone while powered on, showing a working heating element.

risks.risk: Gas burners may not ignite or may have gas leaks.
risks.proof: A video showing each gas burner being lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: Ovens may not heat properly or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven doors opening and the interior lighting and heating elements working.

risks.risk: Electrical connections may be unsafe or improperly wired, especially given the visible wiring in the background.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the electrical connection point and circuit breaker for the cooker.

proof_requests: Video of the induction zone being turned on and heating.
Video of each gas burner being lit and burning steadily.
Video of both oven doors opening and showing the interior and heating elements working.
Photo or video of the electrical connection point and circuit breaker for the cooker.
response.reason: The cooker is identifiable as a Hobart freestanding unit with both induction and gas cooking and double ovens. While the physical condition appears decent, functionality of the induction, gas, and oven components cannot be confirmed from photos alone. Safety of electrical connections is also unverified. Proof of operation is required before pricing.
